steps.title: Prepare PDMS mixture
steps.instruction: Weigh 40.5 g PDMS base (Sylgard™ 184 part A) and 4.5 g curing agent (part B) to obtain a 1:10 ratio; mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Cast and cure PDMS
steps.instruction: Pour the PDMS mixture into the epoxy molds placed in a 10 cm plastic Petri dish, keep molds sealed with parafilm, degas in a vacuum desiccator for 2–3 h until clear, then bake at 70 °C for at least 3 h (up to overnight).

steps.title: Cut PDMS and punch holes
steps.instruction: Using a scalpel, incise along the edge of each cured PDMS cast, remove the cast with a spatula, place it flat, separate chambers, and punch four 5 mm holes (two for the cell‑body compartment, two for the axonal compartment) with a 5 mm biopsy punch, keeping microgrooves facing up.

steps.title: Prepare PDL‑laminin coating
steps.instruction: Mix 1 mL 1 mg/mL poly‑D‑lysine (PDL) in borate buffer pH 8.3 with 0.1 mL laminin (20 µg/mL) and 8.9 mL sterile water to a final volume of 10 mL (final PDL 0.1 mg/mL, laminin 20 µg/mL).

steps.title: Coat coverslips overnight
steps.instruction: Place 25 mm No. 1 glass coverslips on a parafilm sheet inside a sterile 150 mm × 25 mm dish, add 500 µL of the PDL‑laminin mixture to each, and incubate at 37 °C in a cell incubator overnight.

steps.title: Wash and dry coated coverslips
steps.instruction: The next day, remove the coating with a p1000 pipette, wash each coverslip three times with 600 µL autoclaved distilled water using the p1000, then dry completely in a vacuum desiccator; if water remains, remove the coverslip with fine forceps and dry.

steps.title: Prepare borate buffer (pH 8.3)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 155 mg boric acid (3.1 mg/mL) and 237.5 mg borax anhydrous (4.75 mg/mL) in 50 mL distilled water, stir overnight, adjust pH to 8.3, and filter through a 0.22 µm syringe filter.

steps.title: Prepare HBSS 1×
steps.instruction: Dilute 10 mL HBSS 10× with 10 mL 1 M HEPES (pH 7.4) to 10 mM, add 0.5 mL 7.5 % sodium bicarbonate, 1 mL antibiotic/antimycotic 100×, and bring to 100 mL with autoclaved water.

steps.title: Prepare HBSS‑trypsin
steps.instruction: Mix 1 mL 10× Trypsin with 9 mL HBSS 1× to a final volume of 10 mL.

steps.title: Prepare MEM‑HS medium
steps.instruction: Combine 86 mL MEM, 10 mL horse serum (10 % final), 3 mL glucose (0.6 % final), 1 mL GlutaMax (1×), and 1 mL antibiotic/antimycotic 100× to 100 mL total.

steps.title: Prepare Neurobasal‑B27
steps.instruction: Add 96 mL Neurobasal, 2 mL B27 (2 % final), 1 mL GlutaMax (1×), and 1 mL penicillin/streptomycin 100× to 100 mL total.

steps.title: Prepare Neurobasal‑B27 + AraC
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL AraC (1 mM stock) to 990 µL Neurobasal‑B27 (recipe above) to obtain 1 µM final AraC, total 1 mL.

steps.title: Prepare Neurobasal‑CTB solution
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL Alexa‑555‑ or Alexa‑647‑conjugated cholera toxin subunit B (1 mg/mL) to 999 µL Neurobasal to obtain 1 µg/mL final CTB, total 1 mL.

steps.title: Prepare PFA‑sucrose fixative
steps.instruction: Warm PBS to 65 °C, dissolve 0.2 g paraformaldehyde (4 % w/v) and 0.2 g sucrose (4 % w/v) in the PBS, mixing every 5 min until fully dissolved, then bring the volume to 5 mL with PBS 1×.

steps.title: Prepare blocking solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.3 g BSA (3 % w/v) and 50 µL fish gelatin (5 % w/v) in 930 µL PBS 1×, add 20 µL 10 % saponin (final 0.2 % saponin). Total 1 mL.

steps.title: Prepare antibody solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.3 g BSA (3 % w/v) and 50 µL fish gelatin (5 % w/v) in 948 µL PBS 1×, add 2 µL 10 % saponin (final 0.02 % saponin). Total 1 mL.

steps.title: Clean microfluidic chambers
steps.instruction: In a laminar‑flow hood, hand‑wash each chamber for 5 min with 500 mL 2 % Micro90 detergent, rinse six times by placing the chamber in 400 mL distilled water, gently stir 10 min each rinse, then immerse in 100 mL 100 % ethanol for 10 min at room temperature; finally UV‑irradiate for 5 min.

steps.title: Assemble chambers on coverslips
steps.instruction: Place the dried, coated coverslips (substrate side up) in a 35 mm dish or 6‑well plate, add a small piece of tissue paper beneath each coverslip, position each PDMS chamber (microgrooves up) onto the coverslip, gently press to seal, and add 400 µL MEM‑HS medium; incubate at 37 °C.

steps.title: Check for leaks and remove bubbles
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL MEM‑HS to the cell‑body compartment, wait 2–3 min, inspect the axonal compartment for fluid leakage; if bubbles are present, aspirate with a p200 pipette and refill until no bubbles remain.

steps.title: Dissect and dissociate cortical neurons
steps.instruction: On ice, place each E16‑E18 embryo in 10 mL HBSS 1×, decapitate, remove brain, discard meninges, dissect cortex, cut into 0.5–1 mm² pieces, transfer pieces to a 15 mL tube containing 10 mL HBSS‑trypsin, incubate 10 min at 37 °C; prepare three Pasteur pipettes with tip diameters ≈1 mm, 0.75 mm, 0.35 mm by flame‑rounding; wash tissue three times with 5 mL cold HBSS 1×, discard supernatant each wash, resuspend in 2 mL MEM‑HS, triturate sequentially with the three pipette tips until the suspension becomes cloudy.

steps.title: Count cells and adjust density
steps.instruction: Count dissociated cells in a Neubauer chamber, centrifuge if needed, and resuspend to obtain 40 × 10³–50 × 10³ cells per 5 µL MEM‑HS (e.g., for 10 chambers use 5 × 10⁵ cells in 50 µL).

steps.title: Plate neurons into chambers
steps.instruction: Remove MEM‑HS from all four punch holes, add 5 µL cell suspension (40–50 × 10³ cells) into hole 2, pipette up/down three times on each side of the cell‑body compartment (use a p10 tip), incubate 30 min at 37 °C for attachment, then add 60 µL MEM‑HS to each punch hole (total 240 µL) to fill the chamber.

steps.title: First media change (DIV 1)
steps.instruction: The next day, remove MEM‑HS and add 80 µL Neurobasal‑B27 + AraC to each cell‑body hole (1 & 2) and 40 µL to each axonal hole (3 & 4), achieving a total of 160 µL in the cell‑body compartment and 80 µL in the axonal compartment (80–100 µL differential volume).

steps.title: Maintain cultures
steps.instruction: Replace 20 % of the Neurobasal‑B27 + AraC medium every two days to compensate for evaporation; keep the differential volume between compartments constant.

steps.title: Retrograde labeling with f‑CTB (overnight)
steps.instruction: At 5–7 DIV, aspirate all media, add 80 µL warm Neurobasal‑B27 to holes 1 & 2 and 40 µL Neurobasal‑B27 containing f‑CTB (1 µg/mL) to holes 3 & 4, incubate overnight at 37 °C.

steps.title: Time‑point f‑CTB labeling
steps.instruction: The next day, wash the axonal compartment with warm Neurobasal‑B27, then add 40 µL f‑CTB555 (1 µg/mL) to holes 3 & 4 for 30, 90, 120, or 180 min as required; keep cell‑body compartment with 80 µL Neurobasal‑B27.

steps.title: Fix cells
steps.instruction: Remove all media, wash each hole with 200 µL PBS once, then add 100 µL PFA solution (4 % paraformaldehyde, 4 % sucrose) slowly at the edge of the coverslip, incubate 18 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash after fixation
steps.instruction: Remove PFA and wash three times with 100 µL PBS for 5 min each.

steps.title: Block non‑specific binding
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL blocking solution (3 % BSA, 5 % fish gelatin, 0.2 % saponin in PBS) and incubate 1 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Incubate primary antibodies
steps.instruction: Replace blocking solution with 100 µL antibody solution containing mouse anti‑βIII‑tubulin (1:750) and rabbit anti‑Rab11a (1:400), incubate overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash after primary antibodies
steps.instruction: Wash three times with 100 µL PBS for 5 min each.

steps.title: Incubate secondary antibodies
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL antibody solution containing donkey anti‑mouse Alexa 647 (1:500) and donkey anti‑rabbit Alexa 488 (1:500), incubate 1 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash after secondary antibodies
steps.instruction: Wash three times with 100 µL PBS for 5 min each.

steps.title: Stain nuclei with Hoechst
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL Hoechst solution (1:5 000 in PBS), incubate 10 min at room temperature, then wash three times with 100 µL PBS for 3 min each and once with 100 µL distilled water.

steps.title: Mount coverslips
steps.instruction: Place the coverslip (neurons facing up) onto a slide with 50 µL Mowiol 4‑88 mounting medium, let dry at room temperature for at least 12 h, then store at 4 °C until imaging.

steps.title: Conjugate BDNF‑biotin with f‑streptavidin
steps.instruction: Dissolve 5 µg BDNF‑biotin in 50 µL Neurobasal + 0.1 % BSA (100 µg/mL); resuspend 10 µg Streptavidin‑DyLight 488 in 100 µL Neurobasal + 0.1 % BSA (100 µg/mL); mix 2 µL BDNF‑biotin, 6 µL streptavidin, and 72 µL Neurobasal + 0.1 % BSA, incubate 20 min at 37 °C, then dilute with 320 µL Neurobasal + 0.1 % BSA to obtain ~5 nM BDNF‑biotin‑streptavidin (≈150 ng/mL). Use non‑conjugated streptavidin‑DyLight 488 at the same concentration as control.

steps.title: Multilabel experiment (BDNF, CTB, transferrin)
steps.instruction: At DIV 8, aspirate 80 µL from each cell‑body hole and 40 µL from each axonal hole; add 80 µL TrkB‑Fc (100 µg/mL) to each cell‑body hole and 40 µL Neurobasal to each axonal hole, incubate 60 min at 37 °C; then replace axonal media with 80 µL Neurobasal + 1 % BSA containing f‑CTB647 (1 µg/mL) and f‑BDNF488 (150 ng/mL), incubate 180 min at 37 °C; after 150 min, add 80 µL Neurobasal + f‑transferrin 555 (100 µg/mL) to each cell‑body hole for 30 min; finally replace both compartments with warm PBS and proceed to fixation as described above.

steps.title: Acquire confocal images
steps.instruction: Using a Leica SP8 confocal microscope (LAS X v3.5.5), image with 405 nm, 488 nm, 552 nm, and 638 nm lasers; acquire 1 µm (or thinner) optical slices, 6–14 fields per sample, 1024 × 1024 px resolution; for Figure 6 use gain 850, offset 0, laser powers: 405 nm 2–5 %, 488 nm 3–10 %, 555 nm 0.1–0.5 %, 647 nm 0.1–0.5 %; adjust settings per sample.
